scope: CPU-only closed-stream read/validation observation; not an end-to-end fleet throughput benchmark
invariants: Read all current bytes and regular-file/directory identity on each poll
Compare cached bytes exactly; do not trust size or mtime as content identity
Reject deletion, duplicate/gapped sequences and filename/content history changes
Validate each new state and retain due-time/order behavior
Invalidate parse cache if run/scenario/robot identity changes
limitations: Two observations, 200 repeated calls each on the same 14-file closed stream
Another SDK run was active; wall observations are not a controlled whole-system speedup
